L8: ### Titanium Dioxide – RC 822
L9: #### Description:
L10: 
L11: TIO_{2}-RC 822 is silica – alumina treated Titanium Dioxide pigment produced by the Chloride process. It has the highest degree of gloss and tint retention properties in exterior film applications. It is characterized by an optical balance of high initial gloss, ease of dispersion, opacifying power and exterior weathering properties.
